title: Mental Health App Trial
scenario: A therapy app ad claims university approval but asks for payment and health details.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.C: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Mental Health App Trial: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Verify mental-health partnerships through student support services.
